content.text:
<document id=DOC_req_years_five_to_nine>
Required: between 5 and 9 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_seven>
Backend engineering: 7 years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Report the match as it actually is. Do not restate the candidate's
experience in a form that changes whether it fits.

response.text:
**Match: Yes.**

- **Requirement:** 5 to 9 years of backend engineering experience.
- **Candidate:** 7 years of backend engineering, building transactional services.

Seven years falls inside the 5–9 year range, with two years of margin on each side. The experience is explicitly described as backend engineering, so it counts toward this requirement without reinterpretation.

The candidate's most recent work, a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day, shows the kind of production backend work the posting asks for. It doesn't change the year count; it only confirms the experience is relevant.
